hypothesis_source: MA20 reclaim passed vs same-day untriggered leaders. Sequence 4 asks how to buy. Overnight gap-up is the chase leg of a T+1 open fill. Rule: skip the buy when next-open > signal close. Same trigger set, entry filter only. Not a percentage scan.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not the next-open chase percent scan that reversed across years on VCP. Binary: gap up or not. Same reclaim candidates as v1.

entry.definition: Fill T+1 open only if that open <= signal-day close. Gap-up voids the signal, no roll.

control: All T+1 fills of the same reclaim signals (v1).

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of skip-gap-up is not worse than all T+1 fills on the same reclaim days.
pass_fail.fail: Stop skip-gap-up. Keep T+1 buy-all of the reclaim. Do not scan a gap percent.
